lines.speaker: Hexblade
lines.text: Careful. The ash by the crypt door still holds a ward, and it isn't mine.

lines.speaker: Hexblade
lines.text: Someone has been binding the dead to this ground. I mean to learn who, and then I mean to cut the binding.

lines.speaker: Hexblade
lines.text: Your steel and my spells would get there faster. Well?

lines.speaker: Hexblade
lines.text: Good. Take these vials; curses cling here. [Received 2 Holy Water. The Hexblade joins the party.]

lines.speaker: Hexblade
lines.text: Then mind the crypt. I'll be studying the ward.
